topic: Frontend design fixes - search input, calendar popover, spacing

findings.issue: Input text used text-gray-100 (nearly white) on a white background; clear button also text-gray-100
findings.fix: Changed input to text-gray-800, placeholder gray-400, clear button gray-400 hover gray-600

findings.issue: PopoverContent had w-auto p-0 with no height constraint; Calendar component defaults to full-height flex column which stretched the dropdown
findings.fix: Added max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto, p-2, rounded-2xl, shadow-xl, sideOffset=8 to PopoverContent; passed bg-white rounded-xl to Calendar

findings.issue: Filter controls (Search, CategoryFilter, DateRangeFilter, PriceFilter) had no visual grouping; sections lacked horizontal padding separation
findings.fix: Wrapped filter grid in a rounded-2xl glass card (bg-white/10 border-2 border-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 md:p-5); added px-5 md:px-10 to events and CTA sections

design_tokens.calendar_styles: REACT-DATEPICKER STYLES section also exists in globals.css (legacy, for react-datepicker library)

next_steps: Check CategoryFilter and PriceFilter dropdowns render correctly inside new glass card
